text:
Maya: Heads up — I queued 3 small docs PRs that need reviews before Friday's merge window. Can we quickly assign? links: https://git.redwood/pr/312 https://git.redwood/pr/313 https://git.redwood/pr/314
Samir: Thanks — can you flag which are tiny edits vs migration guides?
Maya: PR312 = typo + broken link (tiny). PR313 = SDK snippet update (needs SDK reviewer). PR314 = migration guide v0.8 -> v0.9 (bigger; needs 2 reviewers).
Jen K: I can take PR313 (SDK snippet). Ping me when it's ready for review. :+1:
Alex P: I can grab PR312 this afternoon. For PR314 we should pair docs + eng-runtime. Maybe ask @ryan or @kai as a second reviewer?
Maya: Ryan is out this week, Kai is oncall. Who's on the docs rotation this sprint? @Samir do you have bandwidth to take migration guide if someone from runtime pairs?
Samir: I can take PR314 but would prefer to pair-review with someone from eng-runtime. @Alex P could you do the runtime review? Also FYI CI docs-preview is flaky — last run failed with a broken link.
docs-bot: docs-preview build #542 failed for PR314: Broken link detected -> /docs/api/old-route (404)
Maya: I'll patch the broken link in the PR314 branch now. Also propose a concrete merge policy: small fixes (<=5 lines) = 1 reviewer + green CI, migration guides = 2 approvers + green docs-preview. Make this the default for the sprint?
Jen K: Agree. Also can we add a label `docs-trivial` to auto-signal single-review merge? And update the PR template to remind authors to run `yarn docs:preview` locally before opening?
Alex P: Label and template tweak make sense. I'll create `docs-trivial` and add a tiny GH action to suggest reviewers based on file paths (e.g., `sdk/**` -> @Jen K, `runtime/**` -> @eng-runtime).
Maya: Thanks. Also can we set a merge window for larger docs PRs to avoid CI contention — propose Mon-Fri 13:00–17:00 PST for big merges. Thoughts?
Samir: Works for me. For clarity on this thread: assign PR312 -> Alex P, PR313 -> Jen K, PR314 -> Samir + Alex P. I'll wait for Maya's fix and then run the preview locally.
Maya: Fixed the link and pushed to PR314 branch. docs-preview queued: https://ci.redwood/builds/542
deploy-bot: docs-preview build #543 queued (PR314) — status: running
Samir: Preview passed locally for me after the fix. If CI goes green, I'll merge PR314 during the 15:00 PST slot today. @Alex P please ack when you finish the runtime review.
Alex P: Approved PR312 and left inline comments on 314. Ready to approve 314 after I see the CI pass. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the docs rotation doc with the `docs-trivial` label and the merge policy notes.
